FireRedASR2 standalone inference from FireRedASR2S

Repository: https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedASR2S
Revision: 4e7d9aaf4482a47cec1724807026b9b151926eb5
Upstream directory: fireredasr2s/fireredasr2
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE)

Xinference includes the standalone AED and LLM inference modules. Package
initializers support local imports and setuptools discovery. The entry point
loads LLM dependencies only for the LLM variant.
